title: 花太多了
brief: Left X accepts a single stem from right-hand florist N; N pulls successive bunches from below counter into X’s arms. Flower stack rises to X’s eyes then only silver cowlick visible; X lowers the armful below counter, emerges behind it and starts loop. No more than two hands per person.

board.title: 花太多了
poses: 0.00 s: Draw X on the left, right fingers closing around the single stem in right-hand florist N’s right hand; X’s left palm waits beneath it, and N’s left hand rests on the counter.
0.45 s: Draw X cradling the stem in the left arm, right hand securing it; N reaches the right hand below the counter, and both watch the flower.
1.00 s: Draw N’s right hand releasing the first bunch onto X’s arms at chest height; X looks pleased, and N’s left hand stays planted.
1.60 s: Draw N’s right hand delivering a second bunch from below the counter, raising the stack to X’s eyes; X peers over it with widening eyes.
2.20 s: Draw N withdrawing the empty right hand after adding a third bunch from below the counter; flowers hide X except for the silver cowlick, with both supporting hands concealed underneath.
2.90 s: Draw X bending knees and lowering the entire armful to chest height, revealing overwhelmed eyes; both hands support it underneath while N watches.
3.50 s: Draw X crouched behind the counter, placing the whole armful into concealed storage; only the silver cowlick peeks above the edge while N reaches below with the right hand.
4.00 s: Draw X rising behind the counter with empty hands and a relieved expression; N lifts a fresh single stem in the right hand, left hand still resting on the counter.
4.55 s: Draw X upright with the left palm cupped and open right fingers just short of the offered stem; N extends it toward those fingers, and both watch the approaching handoff.
board.continuity: Use a fixed camera and 4.8-second loop, keep each person limited to two hands and N’s left hand planted, retain all flowers until stored below the counter, and join pose nine’s reaching fingers directly to pose one’s closing grip.
